item.title: Ultrasonic Acoustic Levitation
item.description: The wave physics of acoustic radiation pressure: phased ultrasonic transducers, pressure nodes, Bernoulli forces, and contactless manipulation of matter in air.
item.author: Orion Kaelen

item.title: The Physics of Analog Synths
item.description: An electroacoustic engineering breakdown of analog sound synthesis: 1-volt-per-octave pitch CV, transistor ladder filters, integrator capacitor charging, and wave-shaping circuitry.
item.author: Siddharth Nair

item.title: High-Order Ambisonics & 3D Audio
item.description: Decomposing 360-degree acoustic soundfields using spherical harmonics, B-format polar equations, and head-related transfer functions for virtual reality immersion.
item.author: Orion Kaelen

item.title: Modular Synthesizers & CV
item.description: The electroacoustic physics of Eurorack modular synthesizers: 1V/Octave standards, analog subtractive synthesis, low-pass gates, and generative patching topologies.
item.author: Orion Kaelen

item.title: The Science of Binaural Beats
item.description: How presenting dichotic frequency offsets to the auditory cortex drives neural phase-locking, frequency-following responses, and targeted mental state entrainment.
item.author: Orion Kaelen

item.title: The Physics of Spatial and 3D Audio
item.description: An acoustic engineering analysis of acoustic holophony: Huygens-Fresnel wave synthesis, head-related transfer functions (HRTFs), interaural time difference (ITD) filtering, and next-generation immersive sound fields.
item.author: Siddharth Nair

item.title: The Geometry of Anamorphic Cinema
item.description: A cinematographic optics monograph on cylindrical lens distortion, horizontal bokeh ovality, blue streak flare physics, and photochemical widescreen aesthetics.
item.author: Mateo Silva
